reasons.text: Still below both the 50-day and 200-day averages (~$1.39) and 2.3% below his $1.3724 entry - the higher-timeframe trend hasn't flipped.
The week's structure is lower highs and lower lows ($1.410 down to $1.283); one bounce day doesn't repair it.
Hotter September inflation (3.7% vs 3.6% expected) drove a risk-off flush: $774M in crypto liquidations, ~89% of them longs; over $40M of XRP longs forced out after $1.40 broke.
Regulatory tailwind stalled: the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act and the House Financial Services chair says the SEC/CFTC rules fall short of a lasting framework.
ETF bid paused: zero net flow on Oct 9, 12 and 13 after the long inflow streak.
XRP isn't trading its own story right now: the same risk-off tape dragged BTC from $83.5k to a $79.7k low this week.
Spot XRP ETFs just posted a 12th straight week of net inflows (+$11.3M, Oct 5-9) - the only major crypto ETF group positive that week while bitcoin funds lost $681M.
Adoption keeps building: Standard Chartered launched RLUSD custody on the XRP Ledger (Oct 12); DriveWealth will settle in RLUSD in Europe; Ripple partnered with Privy (Oct 13).
Evernorth (XRPN) holds ~473M XRP as a public treasury - a standing institutional holder, even though the debut itself was a sell-the-news dip.
Buyers defended the floor again: +4.5% off the $1.283 low, back above the $1.31 line, and the 24h print is green (+1.0%) for the first time in days.
